notes.title: Save System (Beta Version)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595451/d71f77c37b3e0934130189ce04738c5444fdb7e5.png"]



In the latest patch (0.6.4) I added the first version of the save system (Steam cloud compatible). This save system is mainly added to debug issues that happen during a run. 



Some players had a crash during a run, with no way to share any data or restart the run. I am hoping that the save system will allow players to restart the run in the case of an unexpected bug. I also think it'll be easier for me to help anyone by simply receiving the save file on Discord. 



This is the first version of the save system so there might be some bugs out there. Let me know if you encounter any issues. 



Thanks,
NourSaiFR

PS: It's worth noting that the demo save file will not be compatible with the full game. This is because I might still make some changes to it before the full release.
